analysis.summary: Fonebox Retail Limited reported a 17% growth in revenue and an 11% growth in PAT for H1 FY25. The company is expanding its store footprint in Gujarat and Maharashtra using both COCO and FOCO business models. Management outlined financial targets, including a revenue target of over 400 crore for FY25 and a projection of 700 crore revenue with an 8 crore PAT for the following year. Fonebox Retail Limited reported its investor presentation for the half year ended September 30, 2024, highlighting operational metrics, active store counts, and financial performance such as revenue from operations and PAT. Management outlined that the smartphone retail market in India was valued at approximately $45 billion in 2024 and is projected to grow at a CAGR of 8-10% from 2024 to 2029.

guidance.claim: The company's revenue target for FY25 is at least 400 plus crore without tax, and around 464-470 crore with tax.
guidance.quote: Our revenue target is 400 plus at least. If we calculate with tax it will nearly around so it is without tax. We are seeing on the balance sheet part on the Tax. With the tax it will lead around 464-470 crore.

demand_outlook.claim: Physical retail sales have been increasing daily over the last six quarters.
demand_outlook.quote: But since last 6 quarter, if we see the data physical retail is being increasing every day.

demand_outlook.claim: Customers are frequently upgrading their mobile phones from 4G to 5G.
demand_outlook.quote: Many of customers are changing their mobile phone from 4G To 5G on a very frequently right now.

demand_outlook.claim: Online sales have been decreasing over the last six quarters due to profit pressures on e-commerce companies.
demand_outlook.quote: As I told earlier, that since last 6 quarter this, online sales is kept on decreasing, there is a reason behind it. So the 1st reason is this, both of e-commerce company is in now under a profit, pressures.

demand_outlook.claim: Growth is fueled by increasing smartphone adoption, rollout of 5G technology, affordable device pricing, and a rising base of young, tech-savvy consumers.
demand_outlook.quote:
This growth is fueled by:
• Increasing smartphone adoption
• Rollout of 5G technology
• Affordable device pricing
• A rising base of young, tech-savvy consumers

demand_outlook.claim: The company's management is optimistic regarding its future prospects.
demand_outlook.quote: The Management remains optimistic about the Company’s future prospects.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to expand first in rest of Maharashtra, excluding Mumbai, with a potential to open at least 100 stores.
capex_expansion.quote: Maharashtra, except Mumbai, 1st rest of Maharashtra, which we call, like Pune, Aurangabad, Kolhapur, Vidarba, Nagpur and all there we will expand first. Once we have a good amount of footprint in Maharashtra. Presently we have only 16 stores live, and Maharashtra at least we can open at least 100 stores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company entered into an agreement to acquire 100% equity shareholding in NWOM Retailers Private Limited.
capex_expansion.quote: the Company entered into a definitive Share Subscription and Purchase Agreement (“SSPA”) dated May 22, 2026, for the acquisition of 100% equity shareholding in NWOM Retailers Private Limited.

capex_expansion.claim: The acquisition consideration of ₹25.74 crore is proposed to be paid through a preferential allotment of equity shares.
capex_expansion.quote: The total consideration for the acquisition is ₹25.74 crore, proposed to be discharged through the allotment of equity shares of the Company on a preferential basis to the existing equity shareholder(s) of NWOM Retailers Private Limited.

margins_costs.claim: Total expenses grew by 18% as the company expanded.
margins_costs.quote: Total expense. Yes, it's been grown by 18%.

margins_costs.claim: The company is focusing on strengthening its operational performance through effective cost management and domestic marketing.
margins_costs.quote: To further enhance shareholder value and sustain the growth momentum, the Company has focused on strengthening its operational performance through effective cost management and enhanced domestic marketing initiatives.

orders_capacity.claim: The company plans for future store counts to be split 70% FOCO and 30% COCO.
orders_capacity.quote: So there will count will be 70-30, like, 70% count will be a FOCO stores and 30% count will be a COCO store.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's borrowings rose to 2.3 crore in September 2024 from 18 lakh in FY24.
capital_allocation.quote: So last year we had a borrowing of rupees 18 lakh in FY-24. In September-24 it rose to 2.3 cr.

capital_allocation.claim: The company obtains interest-free advance capital from NBFCs like Bajaj Finance to facilitate EMI sales.
capital_allocation.quote: For example. there is a Bajaj finance, they give us one crore rupees in advance. We need to reimburse those money by selling phones on the Bajaj finance, which will cost us on 0 interest.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's reserves increased by more than 10% compared to the previous year.
capital_allocation.quote: Last year versus this year's reserve we have increased by more than 10%.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board did not recommend any dividend on equity shares for FY 2025-26 to conserve resources for future growth.
capital_allocation.quote: With a view to conserve the resources for future prospect and growth of the Company, the Board of Directors of the Company have not recommended any dividend on equity shares for the financial year ended 31st March, 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The company spent ₹8.95 Lakh on CSR activities during FY 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: During FY 2025-26, the Company spent ₹8.95 Lakh on CSR activities against the CSR obligation of ₹8.84 Lakh.

risks_headwinds.claim: The Secretarial Audit Report noted a 14-day delay in the submission of the Annual Report to the National Stock Exchange of India Limited.
risks_headwinds.quote: The Secretarial Audit Report contains observations relating to delay of in 14 days in submission of the Annual Report to the National Stock Exchange of India Limited under Regulation 34 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company paid a regulatory penalty of ₹30,000 plus taxes for the delayed submission of the Annual Report.
risks_headwinds.quote: The Company subsequently completed the submission on 14th November, 2025 and paid the regulatory penalty of ₹30,000 (plus applicable taxes) levied by the Stock Exchange.
